title: Splash Course
subtitle: 15 quick Zero Build tips for Fortnite Override, checked and updated
version_note: Chapter 7 Season 4 (Override), after the v42.40 update of 15 October 2026. Based on a creator's launch-week video; every tip re-checked on 19 October 2026.
description: An unofficial Fortnite fan book that turns a YouTube creator's 15 quick Zero Build tips into a guide, then checks every tip against the game as it is now.
glossary_blurb: Every Word Watch word in this book, from A to Z. Like a good Chug Splash, a new word helps everyone nearby. Try splashing three of these into conversation this week.
